title: Heirloom Hydroponics
description: Scientists combine recovered seed with bunker grow-rack designs.

choices.label: Dedicate the lab to it
choices.outcome: {{scientist}} gets the heirloom strains to fruit under grow lamps. Hydroponics is reborn.

choices.label: Plant them outside instead
choices.outcome: The seed goes into ordinary soil and does well enough.

narrative.headline: Heirloom seed under the lamps of {{settlement}}
narrative.text: {{scientist}} spread the recovered seed across a lab bench and began cross-referencing it with the bunker's grow manuals.
